task_completion.description: Measure the distance between the NVP ligand and the catalytic triad (Asp110, Asp185, Asp186).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line (wizard or 'dist' command) is visible in the viewer connecting the ligand to the specified residues, with a distance label shown (approx 8-15 Å).

task_completion.description: Create and save a publication-quality figure to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command history shows a 'png' command targeting '~/PyMOL_Data/images/rt_allostery.png' and the viewer shows a clean, highlighted representation.

task_completion.description: Write the structural analysis report with required data to the specified text file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the creation of '~/PyMOL_Data/rt_allostery_report.txt' containing the distance, chain IDs, and 5+ pocket residues.

integrity.description: The report content reflects the actual measurements taken in the session.

integrity.description: The agent specifically interacted with the NVP ligand (Residue NVP).
integrity.visual_evidence: The ligand is highlighted, zoomed in on, or selected in the PyMOL GUI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 1VRT. The heterodimer consists of Chain A (p66) and Chain B (p51). The allosteric inhibitor is NVP (nevirapine). The catalytic triad residues are Asp110, Asp185, and Asp186 (all on Chain A). The distance between NVP and the triad should be approximately 8.1 to 15.0 Angstroms. Common NNRTI pocket residues include Leu100, Lys101, Val106, Tyr181, Tyr188, and Trp229.
